主要内容: Banro Corporation (NYSE MKT:BAA)(BAA.TO) has closed the remaining US$31.25 million of its previously announced financing, comprising a US$22.5 million term loan funded by RFW Banro Investments Limited (RFWB), a subsidiary of Baiyin Stream Partnership I, LP, and investment funds managed by Gramercy Funds Management LLC. Additionally, Banro completed an US$8.75 million equity private placement to RFWB. The term loan facility, with an initial maturity date of November 30, 2016, may be extended until November 30, 2020, provided certain financial tests are met. The loan bears interest at 8.5% per annum for the first two years and then at the 3-month LIBOR rate plus 8.0% for the last two years. Banro issued 10 million common share purchase warrants to RFWB and Gramercy, with each warrant allowing the holder to purchase one common share at US$0.2275 for three years. Following the private placement, RFWB holds approximately 16.6% of Banro's outstanding common shares. The proceeds from the financing will be used to repay the Twangiza gold forward sale agreements. Banro is a Canadian gold mining company focused on production from the Twangiza mine and the ramp-up to full production at its Namoya mine. The company also aims to develop two additional major gold projects, Lugushwa and Kamituga, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
